description: Return a checkout link for one product in the Niche of One store that NoO Network sells through. Pass a product slug or title. A clear match returns its title, price, checkout link and product page; an unclear one returns up to three candidate products with no link. This tool never takes payment itself: the person opens the link and pays on our Stripe checkout page, and the product is delivered to their email. It does not sell plans or memberships.

product.description: Product slug, or its title in plain words.
